content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Barbara Vitoratos <bvitoratos@gmail.com>
Sent: Monday, September 25, 2017 3:35 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Sunday column 
 
Your column on Sunday is a disgrace.  You hide behind some anonymous source and make disparaging remarks about Victor Martinez.  A player who has had a great career and always tried hard to win is now having his reputation ruined by someone of your pathetic ilk.  Shame on you.
As an aside, I do not believe a word of your nonsense. But that's another topic.
